name: branding-navy-pitch-deck-and-brand-guide-slide-collage-with-italic-serif
title: Navy Pitch Deck and Guide Slide Collage
whatItIs: A pale grey collage of many slides for a finance brand: welcome, contents, why, the opportunity with a silk image, palette (navy and grey swatches), logo, principles, a navy statement slide, brand strategy, an opportunity chart, an Aa specimen with weights and a browser tab mockup, alternating white and navy with italic serif emphasis words.
whatItMeans: Italic serif accents on light sans headlines add elegance to a plain layout, and alternating navy slides give rhythm.
techniques: Italic serif accent word in each headline
Big Aa specimen with a weight list
Line chart with a dotted projection

vocabulary.definition: A word in a contrasting style within a headline.
Repeated header and footer details across slides.
A collage of slides shown together.
